question: What changed in North, and which products contributed to its sales change?

coverage.attestation: Complete hand-authored synthetic ledger, not AdventureWorks. January and February contain all stated transactions; March deliberately contains none.

limitations: Replay tool selections are scripted; results do not establish DeepSeek intelligence, quality, latency or cost.
The baseline is question-agnostic and always selects the largest absolute territory change.
Validity replays aggregate evidence through core; the existing twelve mathematical reference tests remain the oracle.
No causal correctness, business usefulness, generalization or cloud runtime was evaluated.

coverage.attestation: Complete hand-authored synthetic ledger, not AdventureWorks. January and February contain all stated transactions; March deliberately contains none.

missing_evidence: Sales attribution is descriptive, not causal; campaigns, pricing, availability and demand evidence are not present.
Different period lengths and seasonality are not controlled by a comparison of totals.
Completeness depends on the declared source attestation, not the maximum transaction date.
This fixed baseline drills one territory only; other material offsets are not investigated exhaustively.

query_plan.sql:
SELECT TOP (%s) COUNT_BIG(*) AS line_count,
COALESCE(SUM([sales_amount]), 0) AS sales,
COALESCE(SUM([total_product_cost]), 0) AS cost,
COUNT(DISTINCT [sales_order_number]) AS orders
FROM [reporting].[v_internet_sales]
WHERE [order_date] >= %s AND [order_date] < %s;

FROM [reporting].[v_internet_sales]
WHERE [order_date] >= %s AND [order_date] < %s;

SELECT TOP (%s) CONVERT(nvarchar(128), [territory_id]) AS group_id, [territory_name] AS group_name,
COUNT_BIG(*) AS line_count,
COALESCE(SUM([sales_amount]), 0) AS sales,
COALESCE(SUM([total_product_cost]), 0) AS cost,
COUNT(DISTINCT [sales_order_number]) AS orders
FROM [reporting].[v_internet_sales]
WHERE [order_date] >= %s AND [order_date] < %s
GROUP BY [territory_id], [territory_name]
